Ana_Success: Quick heads-up — VeraLogix activity dropped ~68% MoM, active seats 18 -> 4. Renewal ~6 weeks out.
Mohit_CSM: Yikes. Can you paste the last 30/14 day breakdown so we can triage severity?
Ana_Success: 30d total ~145k tokens, 14d ~48k, 7d ~22k. Daily tail pasted below. No alerts in evals.
Ana_Success: ```
2025-03-01 veralogix tokens: 8210
2025-03-02 veralogix tokens: 4142
2025-03-03 veralogix tokens: 915
2025-03-04 veralogix tokens: 118
2025-03-05 veralogix tokens: 95
```
Rebecca_CSM: Procurement reached out requesting alternate pricing and an RFP packet. I spotted a mention of Rivet in their internal thread. I pinged for POC timeline.
Eli_Prod: Any signal of model quality regressions or recent runtime rollouts that could explain drop?
Ana_Success: No quality regressions in our evals, latency p95 looks steady. Noticed KV cache was turned off on their project (manual toggle) — flagging with engineering.
Mohit_CSM: Proposed short playbook: 1) 30-min sync this week with Marcel (procurement) + Sasha or Sasha's proxy. 2) Offer a 2-week, low-cost demo pool to replicate their busiest flows. 3) Send one-page competitive summary (latency / cost / SLA) before the call. Rebecca — can you own the one-pager?
Rebecca_CSM: :thumbsup: I'll draft it. Eli, I need p50/p95 numbers and estimated cost per 1k tokens on Dedicated-4 for seq=512.
Eli_Prod: p50 ~170ms, p95 ~410ms for seq=512 on Dedicated-4. Rough cost math: ~0.007/token for their typical prompt+completion mix; competitor estimate looks ~0.01/token — about ~30% delta in our favor. DMing exact calc and a small graph.
Mohit_CSM: I'll put meeting slots in the shared calendar and invite Marcel + Sasha (or proxy). Ana — can you add a 2-3 example prompts and a short customer value memo to #customer-decks so Solutions Eng can prep a targeted demo?
Ana_Success: Done — added prompt set + short memo to #customer-decks and linked in the calendar invite. Also updated Gainsight: set status=at-risk, playbook=competitive_poc.
Deploy-Bot: Reminder: VeraLogix renewal date is 2025-05-10 — playbook assigned to @Mohit_CSM (automated notification).
Mohit_CSM: If we don't lock a meeting by Thursday, plan B = executive outreach (VP Customer) + a one-time incentive for an expanded POC. Rebecca will bring Solutions Eng into the prep thread.
Rebecca_CSM: Adding SE + sample transcripts now. Will post the one-pager draft in this thread before EOD.
Ana_Success: Requested Sasha's proxy contact from account owner; Marcel prefers Thursday AM. Will confirm immediately after he replies.
Mohit_CSM: Thanks — I'll be ready to escalate if needed. Will update this thread after the sync. :email:
